commands: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs (wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg --release), run as pnpm --filter @holoscript/wasm run build

result.note: Rebuilt so the package's default entry reads frames as pkg-node/ does (claude3's review of PR #456). The previous browser build, from 580d91e32 (2026-08-04), predated G15: it read an omitted allowed_tools as [], which since G15 means no tool, while pkg-node/ read ["*"]. Built from 45ff26c0f; a second release build in a fresh CARGO_TARGET_DIR gave the same sha256, which is also the sha256 of pkg-node/, so both packages hold one WASM. The generated .js and .d.ts are byte-identical to the committed files; only the wasm changes. rustc 1.91.0. No version bump.
